description: Show one MakeViral template: what it makes, its versions (for example solo, with a friend, with a pet), the photos each version needs in order, quality options, optional 'make it yours' fields, the price in credits, the user's credit balance when signed in, and an example clip. Use it when the user names or picks one template. Call it before run_template so you pass the right version and photos, and tell the user the price in credits.
name: get_template
title: Show a template
